The binary gradle-wrapper.jar is intentionally not included in this generated bundle.
Copy gradlew, gradlew.bat and gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar from an existing trusted Gradle project
(e.g. rchia16/smartglassesagents), or run `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.14.1`.
The accompanying gradle-wrapper.properties is already set to Gradle 8.14.1.
